summary: No Ivanovo Oblast-specific signal bearing on transgender visitors was identified in the available sources, and the oblast stands under the national framework of the Russian Federation, so the national assessment applies to it without regional qualification.
tangentialFactors:
All material located for this jurisdiction is countrywide in scope, so no comparison between Ivanovo Oblast and other regions of Russia can be supported; the region is neither documented as an enforcement outlier nor documented as more tolerant than the countrywide position.

The single identified source is a policy and information note issued by the UK Home Office for immigration and asylum decision-making, which assesses Russia as one unit rather than through its constituent regions.
localsOnly: Residents of Ivanovo Oblast are subject to the same national statutes as residents elsewhere in the Russian Federation; no regional measure, regional court practice or regional administrative instruction affecting transgender residents was identified.
outOfScopeNotes:
No court rulings, police operations, regional legislation, detention records or local incident reports from Ivanovo Oblast were located. Whether authorities in the oblast apply the national statutes more or less aggressively than the countrywide average is unresolved.

Countrywide figures on people affected by anti-LGBT+ laws are not disaggregated by region, and no Ivanovo Oblast share of those figures can be stated.
